description:
Lilac 26" Mountain Bike

Step-thru Hi-ten Frame - Easy for ladies and short rider to get on and off the bike.
Front Suspension Fork - Absorbs bumps for a smoother ride.

Dual V-brakes - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.
Professional Drivetrain & XC Tires - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.

Durable and Ergonomic

This features hi-ten steel frame that offers unmatched strength and durability. Its lower step-through design makes it easy for riders to straddle.

This designed frame is also in line with the structure of the human body, making riding more comfortable.

Soft foam saddle ensures comfort and adjustability, thus provides you with a longer and more comfortable ride.

Comfortable & Safe Riding

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path, thus it can effectively reduce the obstructive shock during a ride, thus ensuring that you have an ideal comfortable riding experience.

Equipped V-brakes are lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Professional Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, so you always have the right gear for your terrain to enjoy riding.

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which has strong grip and puncture resistance.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes.

Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Step-thru Frame

Hiland high-carbon steel frame is lower so it's easier for ladies and short riders to stand over and hop on and off.

Professional Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting, which gives you more control for climbing, descents and corners to enjoy riding.

Front Suspension Fork

The steel suspension fork absorbs bumps and dips on the trail, keeping you in full control.

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which have strong grip and puncture resistance.

Master any trail with the Hiland Lilac Women's Mountain Bike. Featuring a 21-speed drivetrain, responsive suspension, and reliable V-brakes for ultimate comfort and control.
